name: toolchain
description: Repo-agnostic polyglot verification toolchain: build + test + lint for changed files across .NET, Python, TypeScript, Bash, PowerShell, Markdown, Go, YAML, and cross-cutting surfaces (`/toolchain:check`, `/toolchain:lint` with format-only `--fix` and gated `--code-fix`), `/toolchain:setup` for the per-ecosystem command config, `/toolchain:ratchet` for a CI ceiling on a count, and a turn-end Stop hook that warns when the recorded check or lint result is not a pass.

turn_end_result_gate.title: Turn-end result gate
turn_end_result_gate.description: What a turn end does when the tree's recorded check or lint result is not a pass: advisory (default) warns and blocks nothing, enforce also blocks once on a recorded FAIL, off stays silent. Honored from user or managed settings only.

ratchet_break_glass.title: Ratchet break glass
ratchet_break_glass.description: When on, /toolchain:ratchet writes break_glass true into a ceilings file that has no break_glass key, so a per-file counter honors an inline exception carrying a reason, an expiry and an approver. Off (default) writes false, so a repository opts in to break glass. The ceilings file's break_glass key wins over this option.
